articles.title: Police search for vehicle after shots fired at 3 Thorncliffe Park apartment buildings
articles.summary: Toronto police are alerting the public about a vehicle of interest they say is connected with shots fired at three buildings in Thorncliffe Park.

articles.summary: Advance voting is underway this week in provincial byelections in Scarborough Southwest and York-Simcoe.

articles.title: Ontario government carrying out major expansion of Durham College Oshawa GO Transit station
articles.summary: Durham College Oshawa station is the eastern end of the GO Transit Lakeshore East rail line. A planned extension to Bowmanville is underway.

articles.title: Ontario expanding Oshawa GO station with 2 new tracks
articles.summary: Construction is underway at the Durham College Oshawa GO station to add two new tracks, the Ontario government announced on Wednesday.

articles.title: York public health agency warns of possible measles exposure at Vaughan, Ont., hospital
articles.summary: York Region Public Health is warning of possible exposure to a confirmed case of measles in the Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital on Aug. 17 and Aug. 21.

articles.title: Newmarket mother, legal advocates seek action after alleged excessive force by fare inspectors
articles.summary: The mother of a 21-year-old Newmarket man who has a cognitive disability speaks out about a July incident involving York Region Transit fare inspectors

articles.title: Bridging hospital to home: How a North York health hub is developing transitional care
articles.summary: A partnership between CAMH and LOFT Community Services is transforming approximately 20,000-square-feet of Champagne Centre into a permanent transitional-care environment, with 40 beds for patients who no longer require acute hospital care but are not yet ready to return home.

articles.title: Toronto police say death of 41-year-old man in downtown home was homicide
articles.summary: A 41-year-old Toronto man found dead in a downtown home last week was a victim of homicide, police say.

articles.title: 3rd man arrested in 2022 Etobicoke shooting that left 2 men dead: police
articles.summary: A third man has been arrested and charged in connection with a shooting that left two men dead and a woman injured in Etobicoke in 2022.

articles.title: Where will cyclists go if Toronto loses major bike lanes?
articles.summary: Ontario’s Court of Appeal has ruled the province is free to remove about 19 kilometres of protected bike lanes on Toronto’s Bloor Street, Yonge Street and University Avenue. CBC’s Trishla Parekh speaks to Cycle Toronto’s Michael Longfield on what alternate route options could look like.

articles.title: Large bronze statue of turtle, 4 smaller statues stolen from Richmond Hill park, police say
articles.summary: A large bronze statue of a turtle and four smaller statues were stolen from a Richmond Hill park this month in what police are calling an "especially troubling" theft.

articles.title: Man charged with 1st-degree murder in 2022 Scarborough shooting: police
articles.summary: A 39-year-old man is accused of shooting and killing Ding Ping Wang in a Scarborough parking lot in November 2022.

articles.title: A federal tariff targeted Chinese EVs. But a Pickering golf trolley company is facing a $183K bill
articles.summary: A Pickering, Ont., business owner who sells golf trolleys says he’s being unfairly taxed under a now-defunct federal tariff intended for Chinese EVs.
